an3.8:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
an3.8:1.3: Savyāpajjhena kāyakammena . . . pe . . . savyāpajjhena manokammena . . . pe . . . Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo. Katamehi tīhi? Avyāpajjhena kāyakammena . . . pe . . . avyāpajjhena manokammena.
an3.8:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
an3.8:2.2: Yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo te tayo dhamme abhinivajjetvā yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo te tayo dhamme samādāya vattissāmā ti. Evaṃ
